horizon_driver: multi-decade portfolio/retirement horizon typical of top-decile asset holders (matches Cartographer's 15yr); this collapses toward an urgent, near-term horizon only when a specific tax or regulatory threat acquires a real legislative vehicle

constraints.source: donor-class political economy: 300 billionaire families contributed ~$3bn (~1/6 of all 2024 election spending), skewed ~5:1 to the GOP; Trump alone received $450m from 150 billionaire families (75% of their $600m total)
constraints.breaks_under: inequality salience crosses a political tipping point where both major parties run credibly on redistribution (not observed as of 2026)

constraints.action: large-scale voluntary capital flight / tax-residency exit from home jurisdiction
constraints.source: estate-planning and relocation costs are real but not prohibitive for the ultra-wealthy
constraints.breaks_under: effective marginal tax rate on capital gains/wealth exceeds roughly 45-50% with credible enforcement

stated_vs_revealed.stated: Public and philanthropic rhetoric from wealthy individuals/institutions emphasizes bipartisan civic engagement, ESG and 'stakeholder capitalism'.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: 300 billionaire families gave ~$3bn in the 2024 US federal cycle (~1/6 of ~$16bn total spent), skewed roughly 5:1 to the GOP; 100 billionaire families alone gave $2.6bn (1 in 6 dollars of all spending); Trump received $450m from 150 billionaire families vs Harris's $143m.
stated_vs_revealed.delta: Stated bipartisan/civic framing diverges sharply from a heavily one-sided, redistribution-averse revealed donation pattern.

stated_vs_revealed.stated: The Federal Reserve's statutory mandate is dual (maximum employment, price stability), not asset prices.
stated_vs_revealed.revealed: The top 10% of US households own ~93% of household equities and the top 1% owns ~54% of public equity markets (up from 40% in 2002); wealth concentration hit a record 31.7% of all US wealth held by the top 1% in Q3 2025 (~$55tn, roughly equal to the entire bottom 90%).
stated_vs_revealed.delta: The official mandate excludes asset prices, but the wealth base whose political voice is most concentrated is overwhelmingly asset-price-linked, which is the structural mechanism behind the Cartographer's claim that this actor's preference is the real constraint on the reaction function.

tripwires.if: a broad equity index drawdown exceeds ~20% and persists more than 2 quarters
tripwires.then: donation and lobbying intensity against restrictive monetary/fiscal policy spikes, and public pressure for a policy 'put' reasserts regardless of the Fed's stated mandate

tripwires.if: a capital-gains or wealth-tax proposal gains a realistic legislative path (e.g., a scheduled committee vote)
tripwires.then: pre-emptive realization/relocation of gains and a surge in targeted political spending against the sponsoring party, visible within one election cycle

what_would_change_my_mind: A wealth-tax or high-bracket capital-gains proposal passing with sustained majority political-donation support from top-decile households, rather than the historical ~5:1 opposition pattern, would falsify the 'donor veto' framing.
